title: Evolution Ledger Entry
description: Schema for a single evolution ledger entry. The evolution ledger tracks every mutation applied during the reroute/overdrive loop — what failed, what was changed, and whether the change improved the architecture. It provides a complete audit trail of architectural reasoning.

iteration.description: The reroute iteration number that produced this entry. Aligns with the audit vector iteration.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this evolution entry was recorded.

failed_layer.description: The architectural layer or phase where the failure was detected (e.g., 'synthesis', 'architecture_generation', 'intent_compilation').

weak_dimensions.description: Dimensions that triggered the reroute. Keys are dimension names, values are the failing scores.

deltas.description: Score changes for each affected dimension relative to the previous iteration. Keys are dimension names, values are delta values (positive = improvement, negative = regression).

reroute_target.description: The phase the pipeline was rerouted to for this iteration.

mutation_applied.description: Precise description of the architectural change that was applied to address the weak dimensions.
examples: Added dead letter queue strategy for all async event channels with configurable retry policy and poison message handling.
Introduced circuit breaker with fallback for Jira integration service. Added health check endpoints to all subsystems.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this specific mutation was chosen over alternatives.
examples: Dead letter queues directly address the failure_awareness gap by ensuring no events are silently dropped. This is the minimal change that maximally improves the weakest dimension without regressing others.

result.description: The outcome of this mutation after re-audit. 'improved' means at least one weak dimension improved without others regressing below threshold. 'no_change' means scores did not meaningfully change. 'degraded' means the mutation caused regression.

post_mutation_scores.description: Dimension scores after the mutation was applied and re-audited. Keys are dimension names, values are new scores.
